prompt:
Use the attached clay render as the exact blueprint. Keep every wall, opening, window, cornice, skirting, floor and ceiling line, the camera height, lens and angle, and the position, size and angle of every furniture piece and built-in exactly as in the clay. Move, resize, add or remove nothing. Each placeholder shape in the clay marks one product listed below; render it there at the stated size. Only turn the clay into real materials and light. The other attached images are close-ups of the exact products: match their form, colour and texture. Positions are fractions of frame width (x) and height (y) from the top-left.

1. PHOTO. Editorial interior for a top design magazine: a Nordic boy's room, 3 pm mid-winter, 24 mm shift lens at 1.0 m, a child's eye height, level, straight verticals, all sharp. Hero: the bed nook in the window corner on the left third, the quiet desk corner on the right.

2. LIGHT. Only key: diffuse daylight from the north window on the left, no direct sun; no lamp is lit in this frame. Exposed for the walls: the white wall above the colour band beside the window reads clean warm white, just under the glowing reveal; the glass one step brighter and still detailed, a pale winter garden. Daylight falls across the bed covers from the left and fades a gentle half stop toward the desk. Each piece has a lit left face and a right side about one stop darker; bed and desk throw long feathered shadows to the right and toward the camera, short dense contact shadows. The ceiling a touch darker than the walls. White balance 4600 K: warm white, never pink, yellow or grey; real contrast, never milky.

3. MATERIALS. Upper walls matte mineral paint #F4F1EC; a crisp sage band #A7B09A to 1.25 m on the bed and desk walls, skirting in the same sage. Floor wide oiled white-oak planks, pale honey #D6BF9E. Bed and desk: oiled oak #C8A27A with a soft satin sheen, one long soft window highlight along the bed rail and desk top and down the planks; no mirror reflection.

4. PRODUCTS, exactly these:
a. ROMAN BLIND inside the window reveal, cut by the top and left edges: flat beige linen roman blind folded up to 1.85 m, no visible cord.
b. BOOKSHELF over the bed foot: two tiers of two natural light-wood face-out ledges with a front bar, each tier about half the bed's length; picture books face-out, covers in sage, oat and charcoal, no readable text.
c. RUG between bed and desk, cut by the bottom edge: a 140 x 200 hand-woven jute flat rug with double ink-black stripes.
d. BEDDING: single duvet cover and pillowcase in warm white cotton with thin dark-grey stripes.
e. On the foot third of the bed: a beige six-layer cotton muslin blanket, folded, soft crinkle.
f. At the head, against the wall: two 40 cm corduroy windmill-patchwork cushions, milky white and dark grey.
g. In front of them: a small cream crochet teddy, embroidered eyes, about a cushion's height.
h. On the rug, cut by the bottom edge: a jute rope cylinder basket with loop handles, a matte white-and-charcoal football in it.
i. DESK, left end: three small natural beech toy cars with round wheels in a row, each about a hand long; the rest of the desk bare.

5. NOT IN FRAME: ceiling lamp, wall lamp, pictures, chair, skateboard, pen cup, other toys, clothes, books off the shelf, screens, plastic, socket, cable, text, people. No sun patches, beams, bloom, haze, glow halos, HDR look, grain or vignette.
